description: Undocumented, argument-less. Running it on a model with 392 background nodes produced no output.
notes: Live-discovered on MPoint3D 9.7 (2026-09-14): 'mpoint ?' enumerates it, but it has no page in the MPM doc tree and no entry in the installed command index (out_commands.txt).

Semantics are NOT established. The command takes no arguments (any trailing token is rejected as 'Unused extra parameter') and no keyword table is exposed. It is documented here only so that a command met in someone else's script can be looked up -- do not infer behaviour from the name.
The other eight 'mpoint node' subcommands are documented; only 'list' is not. Contrast 'mpoint list', which is documented and does produce listings.
